description_en: Garuḍa Nārāyaṇa is located to the left of the street that leads from Mangal Bajar to Lagankhel. The west-facing temple sits upon three plinths. The first plinth is home to a pair of stone lions, whilst the top plinth is guarded by two stone images of the deities Jaya and Vijaya. Inside the sanctum, one can find an image of an eight-handed Nārāyaṇa riding on his vehicle Garuḍa. He is flanked by two standing goddesses, possibly Śrīdevī and Bhūdevī.The temple is sandwiched between a row of one-storey shops. Its single entry door is located on its main western wall. The door is well embellished and boasts a stone semicircular arch and a latticed door leaf. The temple is built on a twenty corner plan (vimaśatikoṇa) and has two bands of decorative terracotta cornice. The roof is a unique octagonal dome inghanṭākāraform and is based on a lotus pedestal that has been painted white.No inscription or any other document providing information about the initial construction of the temple could be found. However, the large size of Nārāyaṇa’s image and the high plinths provide grounds for the assumption that the temple was initially larger than it currently is. It seems that it may have been deconstructed and rebuilt in its present size. In 2017 this temple was renovated by the Department of Archaeology.No social and religious activities are observed in the temple. The main door of the temple generally remains closed.
description_ne: पाटन दरबार क्षेत्रबाट लगनखेलतिर लाग्ने मूल सडक छेउमा यो मन्दिर बनेको छ । बाटोको सतहबाट केही उचो भागमा मन्दिर बनेकाले गर्भगृहसम्म पुग्न सिँढी उक्लनुपर्ने हुन्छ । सिँढीको दायाँ–बायाँ एक जोडा सिंह प्रतिमा स्थापित छन् भने सिंह पछि अजय र विजयको मूर्ति राखिएको छ । गर्भगृहभित्र ढुङ्गाको ठुलो जलहरी माथि गरुडासन विष्णुको मूर्ति रहेको छ । विष्णुको मूर्तिको दायाँ–बायाँ दुई देवीहरू उभिएका छन् । सम्भवतः तिनीहरू श्रीदेवी र भूदेवी हुन् ।यस मन्दिरको निर्माणबारे जानकारी पाउन सकिने कुनै अभिलेख मन्दिरमा उपलब्ध छैन । गर्भगृहमा भएको ठूलो मूर्ति एवं सिँढीको संरचनाको तुलनामा मन्दिरको आकार निकै सानो भएकोले विगतमा अहिलेको भन्दा निकै ठूलो मन्दिर थियो कि भन्ने प्रतीत हुन्छ । हाल इँटको प्रयोगबाट सामान्य शिखर शैलीमा मन्दिर बनाई माथिल्लो भाग घण्ट शैलीमा उठाइएको छ । सन् २०१७ मा पुरातत्व विभागबाट मन्दिर जीर्णोद्धार गरिएको हो । मन्दिरमा कुनै पनि धार्मिक एवं सांस्कृतिक गतिविधि भएको पाइँदैन । मन्दिरको ढोका वर्षभरि नै बन्द अवस्थामा रहेको देखिन्छ ।
